hook_line: INDIA'S RICE PRICES SURGE DESPITE RECORD STOCKS

hook_stat.sub: Rise in India's national average rice price in October from a year earlier

stats.label: Metric tons in government rice stocks on October 1, a record and more than four times the buffer requirement
India's share of global rice trade, as the world's largest rice exporter
Tons in the doubled target for offering government rice to private buyers

diaspora_bullets: Export curbs could tighten supplies of Sona Masoori in overseas Indian stores
Southern premium varieties such as Sona Masoori have nearly doubled in a year
news_summary: Rice prices in India rose 12.5% nationally in October from a year earlier, and some southern premium varieties have nearly doubled in a year, even though government stocks entered the new season at a record 55.47 million metric tons.
payoff: The record stocks are mostly common rice that does not substitute for the premium varieties southern consumers buy.
